text: System access must follow least privilege, role-based approval, and periodic review. Access requests require business justification and manager or system owner approval.
title: Goosle Access Request Policy

text: Privileged access to production systems may require additional security approval, time limits, break-glass logging, and post-use review.
title: Goosle Access Request Policy

text: The employee support agent may explain access policy but cannot grant, revoke, or approve access.
title: Goosle Access Request Policy

text: Employees may use approved AI tools for drafting, summarization, coding assistance, research, and workflow automation when data classification rules are followed.
title: Goosle Responsible AI Usage Policy

text: Employees must not enter secrets, customer personal data, confidential financials, merger information, or unreleased product plans into unapproved AI tools.
title: Goosle Responsible AI Usage Policy

text: AI-generated content should be reviewed by the employee before use. Employees remain accountable for accuracy, confidentiality, and compliance.
title: Goosle Responsible AI Usage Policy

text: Goosle benefits may include health insurance, retirement plans, employee assistance, learning budget, wellness stipend, and paid holidays.
title: Goosle Benefits Overview

text: Benefit availability depends on country, employment type, local plan documents, and eligibility rules. Local plan documents control where they conflict with summaries.
title: Goosle Benefits Overview

text: Employees should update dependent information and life-event changes within thirty days where required by local benefit plan rules.
title: Goosle Benefits Overview

text: Employees are expected to treat colleagues, candidates, customers, and partners with respect. Harassment, discrimination, retaliation, threats, and abusive behavior are prohibited.
title: Goosle Code of Conduct

text: Concerns may be reported to a manager, HR, Legal, Employee Relations, or the Ethics hotline. Retaliation for good-faith reporting is prohibited.
title: Goosle Code of Conduct

text: Managers must escalate safety concerns, harassment reports, bribery concerns, conflicts of interest, and suspected legal violations to the appropriate team.
title: Goosle Code of Conduct

text: Goosle-issued laptops must use disk encryption, endpoint protection, automatic screen lock, and managed operating system updates.
title: Goosle Device and Access Policy

text: Local administrator rights require a business justification, manager approval, and may be time-limited. Admin rights must not be used to disable security tooling.
title: Goosle Device and Access Policy

text: Lost or stolen devices must be reported to Security and IT immediately so remote lock, credential reset, and access review can begin.
title: Goosle Device and Access Policy

text: Goosle reimburses reasonable business expenses that are necessary, documented, and approved. Expense claims should include a receipt, business purpose, cost center, and approver.
title: Goosle Travel and Expense Policy

text: Expense claims should be submitted within thirty days of the transaction. Late claims may require manager and finance review.
title: Goosle Travel and Expense Policy

text: Employees should book standard economy airfare for flights under six hours and may book premium economy for longer business flights when approved.
title: Goosle Travel and Expense Policy

text: Personal travel upgrades, fines, lost personal items, family travel, and unapproved entertainment are not reimbursable unless pre-approved by HR or Finance.
title: Goosle Travel and Expense Policy

text: Employees assigned to an office should work from the office at least three days per week unless their role, location, or approved accommodation states otherwise.
title: Goosle Hybrid Work Policy

text: Teams may set anchor days for collaboration, planning, customer meetings, or onboarding. Managers should publish anchor day expectations at least two weeks in advance.
title: Goosle Hybrid Work Policy

text: Employees may request temporary remote work for focused work, caregiving, health needs, severe weather, or travel disruption when business needs allow.
title: Goosle Hybrid Work Policy

text: Workplace safety incidents, harassment concerns, discrimination concerns, data incidents, and security incidents should be reported promptly through the appropriate channel.
title: Goosle Workplace Incident Reporting Policy

text: Emergencies should be handled through local emergency services first, then reported to Goosle Security or Workplace Operations as soon as safe.
title: Goosle Workplace Incident Reporting Policy

text: Reports should include date, location, people involved, impact, immediate actions taken, and whether urgent support is needed.
title: Goosle Workplace Incident Reporting Policy

text: Engineering, product, design, and support employees are expected to log work time in Jira against the relevant issue by the end of each working day.
title: Goosle Jira Time Logging Policy

text: Jira time logs should use the actual work date, relevant issue key, concise work description, and realistic hours. Placeholder logs should be corrected before sprint close.
title: Goosle Jira Time Logging Policy

text: Managers may review Jira time logs for project accounting, sprint planning, capitalization reporting, and customer support commitments, but logs do not automatically create payroll records.
title: Goosle Jira Time Logging Policy

text: The Goosle employee support agent can look up Jira time logs but cannot create Jira tickets, change issue status, edit assignees, or modify sprint scope.
title: Goosle Jira Time Logging Policy

text: Employees may use an annual learning budget for role-relevant courses, books, conferences, certifications, and workshops when approved by their manager.
title: Goosle Learning and Development Policy

text: Learning reimbursements require proof of payment, business relevance, completion evidence when available, and cost center approval.
title: Goosle Learning and Development Policy

text: Conference travel must follow the travel and expense policy and should be approved before registration when airfare or lodging is required.
title: Goosle Learning and Development Policy

text: Goosle employees may request vacation, sick, personal, parental, bereavement, and unpaid leave. Vacation leave should be requested before the start date and requires manager approval.
title: Goosle Leave Policy

text: Vacation leave requests should include start date, end date, leave type, and optional reason. Requests longer than ten business days may require director review.
title: Goosle Leave Policy

text: Sick leave may be submitted after the start date when the employee is unexpectedly ill. A medical note may be requested only where permitted by local law and absence exceeds five consecutive working days.
title: Goosle Leave Policy

text: Bereavement leave may be used after the death of an immediate family member or household member. Employees should notify their manager as soon as practical.
title: Goosle Leave Policy

text: Personal leave may be used for urgent personal matters, civic obligations, or short-term family needs when vacation or sick leave is not appropriate.
title: Goosle Leave Policy

text: New hires should complete required onboarding tasks in the first ten business days, including security training, benefits enrollment, device setup, code of conduct attestation, and role-specific orientation.
title: Goosle Onboarding Policy

text: Managers should provide a thirty-day onboarding plan with team introductions, first assignments, required systems, success measures, and check-in cadence.
title: Goosle Onboarding Policy

text: New hires should not receive production access until mandatory security training, access approval, and role-based authorization are complete.
title: Goosle Onboarding Policy

text: Goosle provides parental leave for birth, adoption, surrogacy, and foster placement. Employees should notify HR at least thirty days before planned parental leave when practical.
title: Goosle Parental Leave Policy

text: Parental leave planning should include expected start date, expected return date, coverage plan, and any local statutory documentation required by country rules.
title: Goosle Parental Leave Policy

text: Returning parents may request a gradual return schedule for the first four weeks where business needs permit and local law allows.
title: Goosle Parental Leave Policy

metadata.topic: payroll and time off records policy

text: Payroll changes must be performed only by authorized Payroll or HR Operations personnel. The employee support agent cannot change payroll records.
title: Goosle Payroll and Time Off Records Policy

metadata.topic: payroll and time off records policy

text: Employees should report payroll discrepancies through the payroll support channel and include pay period, affected earning type, and supporting details.
title: Goosle Payroll and Time Off Records Policy

metadata.topic: payroll and time off records policy

text: Leave records and payroll records are reconciled according to local payroll calendars and approved absence records.
title: Goosle Payroll and Time Off Records Policy

text: Goosle performance reviews occur twice per year and consider impact, execution, collaboration, customer focus, and role expectations.
title: Goosle Performance Review Policy

text: Feedback should be specific, evidence-based, timely, and discussed between employee and manager before final submission.
title: Goosle Performance Review Policy

text: Performance improvement plans should include expectations, measurable outcomes, support resources, review dates, and consequences if expectations are not met.
title: Goosle Performance Review Policy

text: Goosle collects employee data for employment administration, payroll, benefits, security, legal compliance, and workforce planning.
title: Goosle Employee Privacy Policy

text: Employee data should be accessed only by authorized personnel with a legitimate business need and should be retained according to the records schedule.
title: Goosle Employee Privacy Policy

text: Employees may request access to certain personal data where local law provides that right. Requests should be routed to Privacy or HR Operations.
title: Goosle Employee Privacy Policy

text: Business records must be retained according to the records retention schedule and legal hold notices. Employees must not delete records subject to legal hold.
title: Goosle Records Retention Policy

text: Drafts, working notes, and duplicate files should be cleaned up when no longer needed unless they are part of an active legal hold or business record.
title: Goosle Records Retention Policy

text: Questions about retention, deletion, or legal hold should be routed to Legal Operations or Records Management.
title: Goosle Records Retention Policy

text: Goosle employees must work only from approved countries and states where Goosle is registered to employ staff.
title: Goosle Remote Work and Location Policy

text: Working from a new country for more than ten business days requires HR, tax, immigration, security, and manager approval before travel begins.
title: Goosle Remote Work and Location Policy

text: Employees must not access restricted production systems from unapproved locations or personal devices while working remotely.
title: Goosle Remote Work and Location Policy

text: Employees must protect confidential information, customer data, credentials, and source code. Company data may only be stored in approved systems.
title: Goosle Information Security Policy

text: Employees must not paste secrets, customer data, unpublished financial information, or confidential source code into unapproved tools.
title: Goosle Information Security Policy

text: Goosle requires multi-factor authentication for workforce systems, source repositories, cloud consoles, and production support tools.
title: Goosle Information Security Policy

text: Lost devices, suspected phishing, exposed credentials, suspicious login prompts, and accidental data sharing must be reported to Security immediately.
title: Goosle Information Security Policy

text: The Goosle employee support agent can answer policy questions, look up Jira time logs, and submit leave applications with confirmation.
title: Goosle Supported Agent Actions

text: The agent cannot create Jira tickets, approve expenses, modify payroll, reset passwords, approve leave, change HR records, or decide employee permissions.
title: Goosle Supported Agent Actions

text: Protected actions require backend authorization, typed validation, idempotency checks, confirmation when needed, and audit logging before execution.
title: Goosle Supported Agent Actions
